<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-overview"><ins><nowiki>Fight Overview</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Zamorak has 6 phases that are progressed by depleting his health bar and charging the 6 edicts, or pads, located around the arena. During each phase he will cycle through 3 health bar colours, each with their own effects that dictate the progression of the fight:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/XvTHsFcxSC.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Grey HP:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> The health bar Zamorak starts with and regains between each phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will have accelerated 4-tick attack speed and deal 50% more damage, but </nowiki><strong><nowiki>won't use special attacks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cannot be fully depleted through damage and will constantly regenerate itself at an increasing rate</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Starts at a soft cap that can regenerate itself up to a hard cap of double the starting value</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The soft cap will increase with uninterrupted healing at the current cap</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ A healing tick can only restore </nowiki><ins><nowiki>up to</nowiki></ins><nowiki> the cap if </nowiki><strong><nowiki>current grey HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is lower than it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Damage is calculated before healing on the same tick, even a tiny amount of damage can prevent the cap from increasing</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ DoT effects like </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1" alt="dismember" title="dismember" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are very effective at preventing the soft cap from increasing</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 900% enrage, the regeneration increase will </nowiki><strong><nowiki>carry over between grey HP phases</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon activating a pad, all remaining </nowiki><strong><nowiki>grey HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> will be converted into </nowiki><strong><nowiki>red HP</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• An </nowiki><strong><nowiki>increased grey HP soft cap</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, or hard cap, never carries over between </nowiki><strong><nowiki>grey HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> phases and always resets to the initial soft cap</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/TZEQHE85wb.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Red HP:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> The health bar Zamorak gains upon the player activating a pad</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will have accelerated 4-tick attack speed and deal 50% more damage, and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>will do his next special attack every 11 auto attacks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>first mechanic in red HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> will carry over attacks from the previous </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> phase, see the </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Special Attack Order</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section for more information</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Must be depleted by dealing damage and will be followed by </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green HP</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/GRgpCe9WAg.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Green HP:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Zamorak's </nowiki><strong><nowiki>main health bar</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, and is split into 6 sections representing each phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will have 5-tick attack rate and deal normal damage, and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>will do his next special attack every 5 auto attacks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>first mechanic in green HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> on each phase will happen after </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1 auto attack</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upon depletion of each section, Zamorak will </nowiki><strong><nowiki>regain Grey HP and start the </nowiki><em><nowiki>Channelers</nowiki></em><nowiki> mechanic</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Overall, the progression of the first 6 phases can be summarised as:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Grey HP &gt; charge pad &gt; deplete red HP &gt; deplete green HP section &gt; </nowiki><em><nowiki>Channelers</nowiki></em><nowiki> + grey HP &gt; repeat</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Zamorak's </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> scales between 300,000 and 1,600,000 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> per player, capping at 1740% enrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Phases 1-5 each take up 16% of the total </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> bar, while phase 6 takes up 20%</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At 100%+ enrage, Zamorak will gain an additional 7th phase that will be explained in its own section</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="special-attacks"><ins><nowiki>Special Attacks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Channelers</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Automatically triggered upon phasing Zamorak from </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> into </nowiki><strong><nowiki>grey HP</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A message will appear saying </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>Zamorak begins to draw power and energy from something within Infernus.</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki> , this will spawn a Chaos Witch Channeler in Infernus</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players must enter Infernus with the extra action button </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1" alt="realmmovement" title="realmmovement" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and defeat the witch before being able to charge the next pad</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The witch has 33,000 health </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + 132 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for every 10 enrage increase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is advised to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> towards the witch since it is able to stun</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 500%, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 50% adrenaline and their first ability is </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 1000%+, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 100% adrenaline and their first ability is </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Flames of Zamorak</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will yell </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>This world will burn.</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki> and slam into the ground, dealing 2 melee hits and spawning a line of black smoke between himself and a player</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The melee slam deals more damage the closer the player is to Zamorak, and more smoke will be spawned the further the player is</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Picking up the smoke by walking over it will start a timer over the player that deals typeless damage at the end</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The damage increases and gains additional </nowiki><strong><nowiki>defence piercing</nowiki></strong><nowiki> the more smoke that is picked up</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If the smoke is left on the ground, Zamorak will gain stacks reducing his damage taken</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ See </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>Hex: Twinshot</nowiki></ins></strong><nowiki> further down for additional timing notes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To deal with this, be close to the boss to ensure that minimum smoke will spawn, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, use defensives </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if low HP, and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the timed damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Entering Infernus with the timer running will detonate the damage immediately with </nowiki><strong><nowiki>increased defence piercing</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In group, players standing on the northeast side of Zamorak are higher priority to be targeted for the smoke</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://youtu.be/2YZ5tD-7_1g <nowiki>Flames of Zamorak example</nowiki>]<nowiki> using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-embed src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/2YZ5tD-7_1g" title="" allowfullscreen="1" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Adrenaline Cage</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will say </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>Chaos, unfettered!</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki> then temporarily drops overhead prayers and spawns a cage on the bases' location to bombard with 5 magic attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If no player is standing on the cage location, all players will take heavy typeless damage, have their adrenaline drained, and suffer a heavy adrenaline gain debuff</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Remain still, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• At 1500%+ the player taking the hits will have </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> disabled</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="cept" title="cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from another player will still work</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Chaos Blast</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will curl up and begin charging his attack shouting </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>I will tear you asunder!</nowiki></code></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During this time Zamorak may be stunned enough (equal to team size) and will require a damage check right after, which will then force him to release the attack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If Zamorak is not stunned the attack will be released after 18 seconds</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• He will yell </nowiki><strong><code><nowiki>Feel the rage of a god.</nowiki></code></strong><nowiki> and send a red projectile that deals damage based on how long he was allowed to charge</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The attack has a base </nowiki><strong><nowiki>defence piercing</nowiki></strong><nowiki> of 40%</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use a combination of defensives </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, at higher enrages you may opt to simply not stun and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki> instead</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Infernal Tomb</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak says </nowiki><code><nowiki>Step into the dark... meet your death.</nowiki></code><nowiki>, assigns a rune over each players' head, and transports them to Infernus where chaos demons (amount equal to team size) are marching towards a portal to the main arena</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Each Chaos Demon has 15,000 - 70,000 health </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, capping at 1470% enrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Chaos Demons have an internal Freedom timer of 40 ticks, this decreases to 20 ticks when above 500% enrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306563231790.png?v=1" alt="bindingshot" title="bindingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to keep the demon(s) in place and kill them</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players must go to the same corresponding rune they received overhead to exit Infernus</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Going to the wrong rune will deal heavy damage to all players</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As players are sent into Infernus at the beginning of the mechanic, Zamorak will start charging his </nowiki><em><nowiki>Chaos Blast</nowiki></em><nowiki> mechanic, with only the stun portion required to force him to release the attack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ It is highly suggested to pre-stun Zamorak to keep this damage manageable without </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/URj54bk2bF.mp4 <nowiki>Example clip of proper stun timing here.</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/URj54bk2bF.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Rune of Destruction</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak will say </nowiki><code><nowiki>You're already dead.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and lay a massive red rune around him with a disc-shaped gap</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Black sludge will spawn SSW (South South-West) of the rune and rotate clockwise or counterclockwise sometimes changing direction and stuns those who get hit by it twice</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The red areas deal constant typeless damage to those standing in it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The player cannot teleport to Infernus </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1" alt="realmmovement" title="realmmovement" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for the duration of the attack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The rune can be divided in 12 pineapple pizza slices as showed in the diagram, the black sludge occupies 2 and always moves in steps of 1 slice</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The black sludge will either spawn in 12-11 moving clockwise or in 1-2 moving counterclockwise</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The black sludge will move around the ring, changing position every 2 ticks, 18 times</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The black sludge can randomly change the direction it is moving towards up to 2 times</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/m1UJDNgR4E.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using the image below, you can position yourself in optimal spots depending on the spawn point of the black sludge</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This will buy more time to react to the sludges' movement, allowing you to stay in your damage-boosting ultimates</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If you are unsure, starting SSW, or between 12 and 1 in the diagram, will assure that you won't be hit twice and stunned on the first rotation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/vxsy6VH1YY.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="special-attack-order"><nowiki>Special Attack Order</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The following diagram outlines the pattern of special attacks used by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1" alt="zamorak" title="zamorak" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and how they vary based on when you transition between phases:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/OWvsXcAQax.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The special attack order updates to a new phase when </nowiki><strong><nowiki>red HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is depleted. Special attacks that occur during </nowiki><strong><nowiki>red HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> will still use the previous attack order from </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green HP</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Zamorak's first special attack in </nowiki><strong><nowiki>red HP will carry over auto attacks from the previous green HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><em><nowiki>E.g. if Zamorak uses Adrenaline Cage in phase 3 followed by 2 autoattacks before phasing into </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>grey HP</nowiki></em><em><nowiki>, after the next pad is charged Zamorak will use 3 autoattacks followed by Chaos Blast, then resume using special attacks in 11-autoattack intervals</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Phase 1 </nowiki><strong><nowiki>red HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> doesn't have a previous </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> so the first special attack will simply happen after 5 autoattacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Zamorak's first special attack in </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> will always happen after 1 autoattack before he resumes using special attacks in 5-autoattack intervals</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="common-orders"><nowiki>Common Orders</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The following diagram outlines common special attack orders that players follow for a more consistent fight:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/tOq1z7NGGX.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong>[https://img.pvme.io/images/pc72nOAw4b.png <nowiki>⬥ Order 1 (~9:00 - 12:00 kill times)</nowiki>]</strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Recommended for:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 4000% enrage with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong>[https://img.pvme.io/images/q7oEfqqdfX.png <nowiki>⬥ Order 2 (~8:00 - 11:00 kill times)</nowiki>]</strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Recommended for:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 2000% enrage with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong>[https://img.pvme.io/images/vgh9jnjbkC.png <nowiki>⬥ Order 3 (~7:00 - 10:00 kill times)</nowiki>]</strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Recommended for:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 2000%+ enrage in non BiS</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong>[https://img.pvme.io/images/ilNPOrOYlr.png <nowiki>⬥ Order 4 (~5:00 - 7:00 kill times)</nowiki>]</strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Recommended for:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 4000% enrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 2000% enrage with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong>[https://img.pvme.io/images/hgmi9hCOcZ.png <nowiki>⬥ Order 5 (~4:00 - 6:00 kill times)</nowiki>]</strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Recommended for:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 900%+ enrage in non BiS</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong>[https://img.pvme.io/images/tcLmF8t6vY.png <nowiki>⬥ Order 6 (~3:00 - 5:00 kill times)</nowiki>]</strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Recommended for:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 2000% enrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ 500%+ enrage in non BiS</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Estimated kill times assume phase 7 is one cycled, two cycling adds roughly 1 minute</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Some strategies such as meta </nowiki><strong><nowiki>500% enrage</nowiki></strong><nowiki> assume all mechanics are skipped and are not mentioned</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Non BiS assumes being in stage 2 of the </nowiki><span><nowiki>#upgrade-order</nowiki></span><nowiki>, results may vary</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="hexes-and-edicts"><ins><nowiki>Hexes and Edicts</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Charge Pads</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The arena has 6 pads that you can stand on to charge.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When it is fully charged, Zamorak will stop attacking for a while and your adrenaline bar will be refilled. After this, you will gain an </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Edict</nowiki></strong><nowiki> while Zamorak gains a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Hex</nowiki></strong><nowiki> depending on the pad charged.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will become unable to charge pads during the </nowiki><em><nowiki>Channelers</nowiki></em><nowiki> mechanic. To continue charging the next pad, you must enter Infernus </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1" alt="realmmovement" title="realmmovement" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and kill the witch present.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Hexes and Edicts</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Every time a pad is charged, all players and Zamorak will gain a stack of currently active stacking edicts and hexes, respectively</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This makes it such that earlier pad effects become stronger as the fight progresses</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Note that pads 3 and 5 don't have stacking effects</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><em><nowiki>E.g. if you activate pads 2 → 4 → 1 → 3 → 6 → 5, once 5 is activated rune 2 will have 6 stacks, rune 4 will have 5 stacks, rune 1 will have 4 stacks, and rune 6 will have 2 stacks</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/pAOYodBn8H.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
 ‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>During phase 7, all stacking edicts and hexes have their stack amounts reversed</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><em><nowiki>E.g. Using the pad order in the above example, phase 7 will act as if the pad order were 5 → 6 → 3 → 1 → 4 → 2</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/tOouJ4IzhG.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ A calculator has been made to gauge the effects of each activated Edict &amp; Hex: </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Rune_pads <nowiki>https://runescape.wiki/w/Calculator:Combat/Rune_pads</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/UOtlSkO.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Hexes and Edicts</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Hex: Twinshot, Edict: Anima Flow (Stacking)</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206062498549780.png?v=1" alt="twinshotrune" title="twinshotrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zamorak's attacks deal a second hit at 10% of the original hit, per stack.
⬥ Player's basic abilities have their adrenaline gain increased by 20% of the original value, per stack.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Hex: Smite, Edict: Haste (Stacking)</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206048334393385.png?v=1" alt="smiterune" title="smiterune" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ If Zamorak's targets are hit below 5% (per stack) of their Constitution level (times 100), they'll be executed instantly.
⬥ Your ability cooldowns are reduced by 8% of the original cooldown per stack.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Hex: Coven, Edict: Inner Chaos (Non-Stacking)</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206032773517364.png?v=1" alt="covenrune" title="covenrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zamorak calls forth some of his coven to support him. Lifeweaver will continually heal Zamorak for 1,000 health every few ticks, while Protector applies a buff that reduces the damage he takes by 25%. These enemies will spawn to the far west and east (by the second and fifth runes) respectively, but will not move towards Zamorak until a player is in mini-map range of them.
⬥ When standing near a hexed rune, you deal and take 5% more damage.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Hex: Disintegrate, Edict: Guardian's Triumph (Stacking)</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206018680668171.png?v=1" alt="disintegraterune" title="disintegraterune" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Zamorak's attacks push 7% of damage through any shielding effects, per stack.
⬥ After casting an ultimate ability, your next basic ability consumes Guardian's Triumph, increasing the damage it deals by 20% damage and heals you for 8% of your missing LP per stack. Has a 30s cooldown.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Hex: Chaos Traps, Edict: Sword of Edicts (Non-Stacking)</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206002658431016.png?v=1" alt="chaostrapsrune" title="chaostrapsrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Upon activation, Zamorak spawns traps across the arena that deal spike magic damage as you walk over them. Traps will spawn around the arena and on all runes each time a rune is activated.
⬥ Temporarily siphon the dwindling defensive power from the sword, dealing and taking 5% less damage while standing near it. Also protects against the damage, stun and bind when setting off Chaos Traps. Lasts 30 seconds and has a 60 second cooldown.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Hex: Affliction, Edict: Balance of Power (Stacking)</nowiki></u><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994205987663794206.png?v=1" alt="afflictionrune" title="afflictionrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ When Zamorak's targets heal, the amount will be reduced by 10% per stack.
⬥ While below 60% lifepoints, outgoing damage is increased by 6% per stack.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="hex-twinshot"><ins><nowiki>Hex: Twinshot</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Twinshot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206062498549780.png?v=1" alt="twinshotrune" title="twinshotrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from pad 1 and Disintegrate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206018680668171.png?v=1" alt="disintegraterune" title="disintegraterune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from pad 4 will result in the largest increases in incoming damage, especially when they are ramped up in later phases</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Twinshot</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206062498549780.png?v=1" alt="twinshotrune" title="twinshotrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> deals a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>second hit 1 tick after all of Zamorak's autoattacks</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, equal to 10% of the possible max hit per stack, which allows for less </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> uptime and creates special hit timings to be wary of once it's active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During </nowiki><strong><nowiki>grey HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>red HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, Zamorak will have an accelerated 4-tick attack rate, meaning </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="deflectrange" title="deflectrange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will have to be active 1/2 of the time with twinshot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206062498549780.png?v=1" alt="twinshotrune" title="twinshotrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• During the </nowiki><em><nowiki>Flames of Zamorak</nowiki></em><nowiki> mechanic, if the black smoke is picked up immediately, the timed damage will occur on the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>same tick as a twinshot hit during grey HP and red HP</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This will make it impossible to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the timed damage unless </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is also used</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Note that entering Infernus </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1" alt="realmmovement" title="realmmovement" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or phasing Zamorak between </nowiki><strong><nowiki>red HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki>/</nowiki><strong><nowiki>grey HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>green HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, causing his attack speed to change, while the timer is running can cause the damage to line up with an attack regardless of twinshot being active or not</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="hex-disintegrate"><ins><nowiki>Hex: Disintegrate</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Disintegrate</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206018680668171.png?v=1" alt="disintegraterune" title="disintegraterune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from pad 4 grants Zamorak </nowiki><strong><nowiki>7% defence piercing per stack on his attacks</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, stacking with existing defence piercing values such as </nowiki><em><nowiki>Chaos Blast</nowiki></em><nowiki>: 40% and </nowiki><em><nowiki>Flames of Zamorak</nowiki></em><nowiki> Smoke damage: 1% per stack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This only affects the following defensives:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Disruption shield </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Barricade </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Resonance </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Divert </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Reflect </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Debilitate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Shield dome </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1" alt="shielddome" title="shielddome" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The % damage taken through a defensive affected by disintegrate is calculated as follows</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><code><nowiki>= floor(Defensive_value * (Disintegrate_stacks * 0.07 + Base_piercing) + (100 - Defensive_value))/100</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Given the way some defensives are calculated through this effect, this results in a buff and debuff on certain aspects of them:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Reflect </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage </nowiki><strong><nowiki>increases</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as more damage taken results in more damage reflected</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Resonance </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> healing </nowiki><strong><nowiki>decreases</nowiki></strong><nowiki> since disintegrate results in less damage blocked</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="hex-chaos-traps"><ins><nowiki>Hex: Chaos Traps</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Once the Chaos Traps rune </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206002658431016.png?v=1" alt="chaostrapsrune" title="chaostrapsrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active from pad 5, traps will spawn in </nowiki><strong><ins><nowiki>set</nowiki></ins></strong><nowiki> locations. The locations on the map below are possible locations where the traps may spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Note that </nowiki><strong><nowiki>traps respawn on every pad each time a new pad is charged</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To avoid being stunned and taking heavy damage, you can:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Step off each pad right as it finishes charging (new traps spawn with a slight delay)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pick up the buff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006128082266107954.png?v=1" alt="swordofedictsedict" title="swordofedictsedict" kind="icon" /><nowiki> near the sword before charging a new pad</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to step on a new pad without the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006128082266107954.png?v=1" alt="swordofedictsedict" title="swordofedictsedict" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/6dVF9SM48q.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="phase-7"><ins><nowiki>Phase 7</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/WavFFAD1rN.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
At 100% enrage, phase 7 is introduced. Zamorak will enter Infernus and force the player in along with them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When the phase starts:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The pad order from phases 1-6 is reversed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak starts immune to damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Chaos Demon will spawn which should be killed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Zamorak sends 2 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits to all players</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="rune-calls"><nowiki>Rune Calls</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ An amount of runes (2 in solo, otherwise equal to team size in group) will appear before Zamorak and stay there temporarily, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>the order in which they appear is the order they must be defeated in</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At the same time Zamorak will begin charging a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>new red HP bar, referred to as the chaos bar</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, that determines the damage of upcoming mechanics</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994206048334393385.png?v=1" alt="smiterune" title="smiterune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may be shown twice</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing a rune will delay Zamorak from charging for 9 ticks (4 ticks at 1600%+ enrage)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Killing a rune out of order will deal heavy damage to all players</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Runes uber heal after they are defeated, be careful not to kill it twice.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The rate of charge increases with enrage and caps at 8850%</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After the last rune is defeated Zamorak stops charging, becomes damageable, and uses in this order:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [1] A single moderate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [2] A large chaos damage hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Soft typeless damage that is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>equivalent to the chaos bar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> that charges while killing runes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Make sure your team is spread out as it does damage in a small area around each player</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Has a base </nowiki><strong><nowiki>defence piercing</nowiki></strong><nowiki> of 50%</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [3] 4 additional small chaos damage hits</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Deals damage based on a portion of the chaos bar and the amount of time it was allowed to charge for</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Does not have base defence piercing but is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>affected by Twinshot</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If Zamorak is not defeated before becoming immune on the 4th small chaos hit:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [4] Another Chaos Demon spawns</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [5] Another moderate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [6] Another large chaos damage hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [7] Runes are called</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Resets to [1] once last rune is defeated</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Zamorak will have 100,000 to 250,000 health </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki> per player during phase 7, capping at 1000% enrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Chaos Demon is the same as during the </nowiki><em><nowiki>Infernal Tomb</nowiki></em><nowiki> mechanic and will have 18,750 to 70,000 health </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250887712902.png?v=1" alt="constitution" title="constitution" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, capping at 1470% enrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At 1000% enrage the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>chaos bar</nowiki></strong><nowiki> charge no longer resets between cycles, meaning the chaos damage will likely become unmanageable in a second cycle</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It's generally expected for Zamorak to be low enough at this point to defeat before the large chaos hit reaches the player, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="rod" title="rod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can also be used to buy more time</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Each small chaos damage hit is calculated as follows:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>= floor(Iteration * Chaos_bar/100)</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎where </nowiki><code><nowiki>Iteration</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎refers to how many times the Charge value has increased (this gets delayed when killing a rune)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Final phase (Solo </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 440%)</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/gQrldqS.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-7-general-strategy"><nowiki>Phase 7 General Strategy</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>After entering Infernus:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Team kills the Chaos Demon</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Before Zamorak calls runes, team gets ready to ult </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1" alt="livingdeath" title="livingdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki>**</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Team kills runes as soon as they appear, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>being careful not to kill them twice unintentionally</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Team gets on Zamorak immediately after killing last rune</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will want to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the melee hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the large bomb, less defensives will be required with lower (&lt;10k) charge</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Repeat cycle if necessary</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When 0 cycling a riskier approach is taken to deal out as much damage as possible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You will want to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the melee hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="rod" title="rod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the large bomb and finish Zamorak</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>0 cycling means killing Zamorak before small bombs hit, risking death if not</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>See enrage and style-specific Zamorak guides for full working rotations</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="phase-7-troubleshooting"><ins><nowiki>Phase 7 Troubleshooting</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Taking too much damage?</nowiki></u><nowiki>
Note: refer to !p7skulls in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#bot-commands</nowiki></span><nowiki> if struggling with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> bouncing to runes
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Edict Order</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (see !edicts for recommendations)
    • A late edict 4 leads to less effective defensives.
    • An early edict 6 leads to lesser healing food.

⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Rune Killing Speed</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
    • Killing the first rune </nowiki><strong><em><nowiki>immediately</nowiki></em></strong><nowiki> is imperative as Zamorak's red bar stops charging for 10 ticks (5 ticks at 1600+ enrage) following each rune death. The red bar directly correlates to the damage you receive.

⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Defensive Usage</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
    • Pre-</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the initial </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hit?
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the Large Smoke?
            • Full hp when using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki>?
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Not dealing enough damage to one-cycle?</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Damage Checklist
    • Delaying </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455640215633.png?v=1" alt="overpowerigneous" title="overpowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> until after the Large Smoke?
            • This is to benefit from edict 6 effect (low HP damage bonus)
    • Stacking 7+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1" alt="StormShards" title="StormShards" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during p1-6 and using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1" alt="Shatter" title="Shatter" kind="icon" /><nowiki>? 
    • Using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to reach Zamorak after final Rune death?

⬥ Preparing for a Second Cycle
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the 2nd melee hit, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1" alt="sd" title="sd" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
      OR
    • </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the 2nd melee hit, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="enrage-based-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Enrage-Based Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Zamorak's damage and HP scales with enrage, and additional mechanics are introduced at specific enrage thresholds:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>100%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Phase 7 is introduced</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>500%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> During </nowiki><em><nowiki>Infernal Tomb</nowiki></em><nowiki>, all players must be on their rune at the same time to exit Infernus</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>500%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> During </nowiki><em><nowiki>Channelers</nowiki></em><nowiki>, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 50% adrenaline and the first ability is Asphyxiate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833072672778.png?v=1" alt="asphyx" title="asphyx" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>750%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> During </nowiki><em><nowiki>Infernal Tomb</nowiki></em><nowiki>, demons will move faster towards the portal</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>900%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> During </nowiki><em><nowiki>Channelers</nowiki></em><nowiki>, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>grey HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> healing ramp-up no longer resets between phases</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> During </nowiki><em><nowiki>Channelers</nowiki></em><nowiki>, Chaos Witch Channeler spawns with 100% adrenaline and their first ability is Omnipower </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> On phase 7, red bar charge is no longer reset between cycle(s)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1000%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> On phase 7, Zamorak's life points cap at 250,000 per player</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1470%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> The life points of chaos demons cap at 70,000 while on Infernus</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1500%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> During the Adrenaline Cage attack, the targeted player will have their Devotion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> deactivated</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1600%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Zamorak's stagger after killing a rune on Phase 7 reduced from 10 to 5 ticks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1740%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> For phases 1-6, Zamorak's starting life points cap at 1,600,000 per player</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>3500%</nowiki></strong><nowiki> On phase 7, the life points the runes revive with are capped at 60,000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="helpful-tips"><ins><nowiki>Helpful Tips</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The </nowiki><strong><nowiki>grey HP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> soft cap can't increase on the ticks Zamorak takes damage, meaning DoT abilities such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062910113714297.png?v=1" alt="dismember" title="dismember" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used before entering Infernus </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1073955377537876089.png?v=1" alt="realmmovement" title="realmmovement" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to prevent meaningful amounts of healing</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As Infernal Tomb starts, you can </nowiki><ins><nowiki>on tick</nowiki></ins><nowiki> stun Zamorak by using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as he assigns runes and using a stun as your character is lifted. </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/URj54bk2bF.mp4 <nowiki>Example clip here.</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This will greatly reduce the damage dealt to players</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can double stun by stalling one and releasing it with another, this counts as two stuns and lets you cover one missed stun</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can stack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1" alt="stormshards" title="stormshards" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to use with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1" alt="Shatter" title="Shatter" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during phase 7</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At high enrages the base can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1" alt="enfeeble" title="enfeeble" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to reduce the damage dealt by autos</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki> also reduces a lot of damage since Zamorak uses a lot of autos</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ring of Death </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="rod" title="rod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> effect clears upon entering phase 7</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Many debuffs such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1404885709034229922.png?v=1" alt="flameboundrival" title="flameboundrival" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> carry over into phase 7</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You may </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> other players and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if multiple players will take a fatal attack at the same time</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/URj54bk2bF.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
